visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a large, circular, minimalist fountain basin that resembles a giant dark pot. It is filled to the very brim with water, which overflows with perfect symmetry along its entire polished edge, creating a seamless curtain of water that drops onto a bed of small grey pebbles. Neatly manicured green hedges are visible in the background under natural daylight. (2) The perspective shifts to a medium-wide shot of the fountain's placement in a serene outdoor courtyard. The ground is paved with stone, and several trees with flat, umbrella-like canopies are spaced evenly around the area. In the distant background, there are white umbrellas and a modern white building where people are seated at tables, suggesting a sophisticated public park or museum garden. (3) The camera provides an extreme close-up of the fountain's edge, focusing on the surface tension of the water as it cascades down. The dark, polished metal of the basin reflects the surrounding greenery. A hand briefly enters the frame to point at the perfectly level flow, emphasizing the technical precision of the craftsmanship. (4) A man with a trimmed beard and a grey baseball cap worn backwards appears in a low-angle shot, squatting next to the fountain. He is dressed in a black zip-up hoodie. He reaches into the falling water with his bare hand to demonstrate the flow. Finally, the shot transitions to a selfie perspective where he talks directly to the camera against the backdrop of the garden.
